subject.title: chore(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates

question: Is exact-head macOS compilation and testing sufficient for this four-package batch, or must Sparkle and Peekaboo also pass signed packaged-app smoke before merge?
rationale: Direct source inspection found no concrete incompatibility, but the acceptable release proof depth for the production updater and UI-automation runtime depends on macOS ownership and release expectations.

options.title: Require packaged smoke
options.body: Keep the four updates together and require exact-head compile/test plus signed Sparkle initialization and Peekaboo runtime smoke.

options.title: Split runtime dependencies
options.body: Move Sparkle and Peekaboo into focused PRs with independent packaged-runtime validation.

recommendation.title: Require packaged smoke
recommendation.body: Keep the four updates together and require exact-head compile/test plus signed Sparkle initialization and Peekaboo runtime smoke.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-history owner for the affected package declarations, Peekaboo runtime integration, and macOS signing surface.
